relationships.evidence: a changed SetSafeArea value iterates connected players and applies the world-area transition policy before marking the world state dirty
the shared Discipline authority calls the player eligibility virtual before either native or targeted commit
ordinary Discipline eligibility composes the shared player-action blocker after the Bloodbuff LockPick exception branch
Weapon_CanSwitchTo uses the shared blocker and refuses every Elysium candidate except item_w_unarmed
feed eligibility uses the shared blocker before the grapple/feed transaction
the sole criminal incident thunk calls its consumer only when world m_nAreaType is nonzero
the sole supernatural incident thunk admits Masquerade and optional police policy only when world m_nAreaType is nonzero

findings.fact: The world singleton owns one clamped three-state area type: 0 combat, 1 safe or Masquerade, and 2 Elysium.
findings.evidence: CWorldEvents SetSafeArea, the safearea callback and World Activate all normalize the field at world +0x49c. DT_WORLD sends it as a two-bit m_nAreaType property; map worldspawn safearea keys and Python world.SetSafeArea calls author it.
findings.consequence: Zone legality is world authority shared by every player, not a volume flag or durable property stored on each player.

findings.fact: A changed area type applies immediate player policy before publication.
findings.evidence: SetSafeArea iterates connected players. State 2 equips item_w_unarmed and removes all owned active and targeted Discipline effects; state 1 ends compiled Discipline indices 3 and 11, Celerity and Protean; state 0 has no immediate teardown.
findings.consequence: Entering Elysium and entering a safe area are transitions with teardown effects, not only future-request predicates or HUD changes.

findings.fact: Elysium pre-commit legality is composed through the shared player-action blocker and the Discipline eligibility virtual.
findings.evidence: The shared blocker terminally tests area type 2 or nofrenzyarea and is called by weapon, feed and Discipline decisions. DisciplineUseAuthority invokes eligibility before either execution family; Weapon_CanSwitchTo permits only item_w_unarmed in Elysium.
findings.consequence: Forbidden verbs must fail before blood, target effects, feed state or attack state commits; client presentation cannot be authoritative.

findings.fact: Bloodbuff while lockpicking is the exact native Elysium exception.
findings.evidence: Player eligibility returns true before the ordinary blockers only for compiled Discipline index 4 when the retained action target resolves and reports compact player action 300 LockPick.
findings.consequence: The exception is neither a general Bloodbuff allowance nor a UI special case; it depends on retained lockpick action state.

findings.fact: Combat area suppresses terminal criminal and supernatural incident admission even though activity production and NPC witnessing are zone-independent.
findings.evidence: The sole criminal and supernatural incident thunks test world m_nAreaType != 0 before entering police or Masquerade policy. The upstream activity setters, Discipline commit and NPC witness transaction do not receive the zone.
findings.consequence: The faithful law path needs both distributed witnessing and one late combat-zone guard; neither alone reproduces the transaction.

findings.fact: Replication and map re-authoring are proved, but same-map save and restore persistence is not.
findings.evidence: m_nAreaType is present in DT_WORLD and each map can author worldspawn safearea; dynamic scripts call world.SetSafeArea. The current static pass did not establish a save-datamap record for the field.
findings.consequence: Map travel must take the destination world baseline; save-load retention remains a controlled retail acceptance question.
